name: Fake retailer store reveal (pallet / unveil) + 'JK, we make them' twist
status: PROVEN on FB (two 1.4M). Largest external decor reel (IKEA X Christmas 17.4M) is the crowd-unveil variant. JK twist mandatory (omar_decisions #2).
summary: Open on an impossible-looking branded pallet of the product in a Target/Walmart-style aisle (slow push-in, no person), or staff pulling a cloth off it in front of a crowd. Hold the store claim through the try-on, then flip the text to 'JK, We make them🎅🎄' exactly on the activation cut.
why: PALLET opener had the best hit rate of any HJ archetype: 5/6 fresh posts ≥50K (83%, CI 44-97%), median 206K, best 1.4M ×2 (hooks REPORT §1.4).
The pallet carries it, not the store word: store-named hooks WITHOUT a pallet got 6.2K (Costco), 3.9K (Walmart), 2.7K (MerryFires Target) (PLAYBOOK §1.1; hooks §1.4).

External: merryglow.official IKEA X Christmas 17.4M (26,987 comments); re-shoot with new talent 755K; deseos.del.polo.n COSTCO X Navidad 2.2M / 31.6K shares; tryglowmas Costco pallet 246K (V; external §2-3).
The JK flip resolves the false claim and is Omar's standing rule; AI 'stocked at Target/Costco' reels drew public scam accusations in Aug 2026 (V, retailer-name risk).

product_fit.evidence: ext IKEA X Christmas 17.4M + 755K, COSTCO X Navidad 2.2M; own Merry Carrier 62.0K used staff holding the LIT product (no pallet)

rules: Hold the pallet ~3 s with no person; then the hand pull (PLAYBOOK §5.5).
JK flip lands exactly on the activation-insert cut at 54-66% of runtime, never mid-shot (body REPORT §7).
Crowd-unveil variant may hold the hook 3.9-4.7 s (external winners) but the cloth must start moving by 2 s.

text.style: Same house style (top-centre 13-20%, white + outline). Two cards only: store claim 0 → activation cut; JK line activation cut → end.

patterns.pattern: {Holiday}-HOLICS RUN, dont walk to {Store} 🎅🎄 → JK, We make them🎅🎄
Christmas Moms don't walk RUN to {Store}!🎄👀 (pallet mob)

rules: ALWAYS add the JK flip (Omar). On reels whose proven version held the store text (1.4M Target), add the flip at the activation cut anyway.
Store-name without a pallet or lit product at 0 s is banned (6.2K, 3.9K, 2.7K).
Proven stores: Target, Walmart (internal); IKEA, Costco with pallet (external). A fictional store is the low-risk variant.

checks.rule: opening_archetype in {PALLET, UNVEIL} and brand box art visible at 0 s
JK text event within ±1 frame of the activation cut, at 54-66%
no face in H1 for the pallet variant

open: Whether the 1.4M Target would have done better with a JK flip is unknown (it had none).
No Insights retention for HJ store reels.
review: Is the twist landing on a beat a viewer will see? The flip is pinned to the PLUG cut, the only handheld macro in the body, so it reads as a 'new scene'.
Is 5 gens too expensive? The pull is the reveal; cutting it to one gen drops the hand-pull mechanic that both 1.4M reels used.
